_metadata.description: Best available clinical Cmax/AUC reference values for gold-24 benchmark drugs. Replaces synthetic 1-cpt benchmark CSVs for drugs with real clinical data. See 'data_quality' field: 'clinical' = real C(t) study, 'clinical_dose_normalized' = scaled from nearby dose, 'fda_label' = from FDA label pk_params, 'synthetic' = 1-cpt generated (not real).

data_quality_codes.fda_label_exact: Directly from FDA label at exact benchmark dose — highest confidence
data_quality_codes.clinical_exact: Real PK-DB C(t) study at exact or near-exact benchmark dose
data_quality_codes.clinical_dose_normalized: Real PK-DB C(t) dose-normalized — assume linear PK, moderate confidence
data_quality_codes.fda_label_dose_normalized: FDA label scaled to benchmark dose — moderate confidence

warfarin.source: PK-DB: Baekdal2019 (PMID:30945118), 10mg oral, n=52. Already in benchmark CSV.

ibuprofen.source: FDA label (NDA 019842): 400mg single oral dose fasted

midazolam.source: PK-DB: Gorski2003 (PMID:12966371), 2.5mg oral, n=52. Dose-normalized: x0.8 (2.0/2.5mg). Linear PK assumption validated.
midazolam.note: Cmax=0.03435 at 2.5mg x0.8=0.02748. Midazolam PK is linear in 1-5mg range.

caffeine.source: PK-DB: Edwards2017, 200mg oral, n=24, healthy volunteers. Dose-normalized: x0.5 (100/200mg). Cmax=5.207 at 200mg x0.5=2.6035.
caffeine.note: CORRECTED 2026-03-18: Wahllaender1990 was a LIVER DISEASE patient study (impaired CYP1A2 clearance → elevated Cmax=9.55 mg/L at 200mg → dose-norm 4.78). Replaced with Edwards2017 (healthy volunteers, DDI study context, n=24, 200mg, Cmax=5.207 → dose-norm 2.60). Caffeine PK is linear in 50-400mg range. Consistent with literature: typical 100mg Cmax 1.5-3 mg/L in healthy adults.

theophylline.source: PK-DB: Becker1984 (PMID:6700656), 250mg oral. Dose-normalized: x1.2 (300/250mg). Consistent with reference_database pk_cmax=14.5 at unknown dose.
theophylline.note: Theophylline PK is linear at therapeutic doses. Consistent with FDA label range 10-20mcg/mL.

acetaminophen.source: PK-DB: Prescott1993 (PMID:9114910) via reference_database. Curve Cmax=15.18 mg/L at 1000mg oral.
acetaminophen.note: Reference_database dose_mg field shows 20mg (likely unit error — concentrations are physiological for 1000mg). Cmax=15.18 consistent with literature 10-25 mg/L for 1000mg oral acetaminophen.

omeprazole.source: PK-DB: Elkoshi2002 (PMID:29492852), 40mg oral, n=40. Dose-normalized: x0.5 (20/40mg). Non-linear PK caution.
omeprazole.note: Omeprazole has dose-dependent PK due to CYP2C19 autoinhibition. First-dose normalization may underestimate 20mg Cmax. Use with lower confidence. Consistent with reference_database curve_cmax=0.282 at 40mg x0.5.

verapamil.source: PK-DB: Rebello2011 (PMID:20413453) via reference_database pk_params.cmax_mg_L=0.077. Exact benchmark dose.
verapamil.note: pk_cmax=0.077 consistent with literature 50-100 ng/mL for 80mg oral verapamil IR. Note: reference_database ct_curve_cmax=0.199 appears incorrect (likely different study arm or unit issue); using pk_cmax directly.

amoxicillin.source: FDA label (Amoxil NDA 050821): 500mg oral capsule single dose fasted, Cmax≈7.5 µg/mL at 2h.
amoxicillin.note: Exact benchmark dose. Synthetic reference was 9.52 mg/L (27% too high). FDA label 7.5 µg/mL well-established for amoxicillin 500mg capsule.

metformin.source: FDA label (Glucophage NDA 021202): 500mg single oral dose fasted, Cmax=1.03 µg/mL at 2.5h.
metformin.note: Exact benchmark dose (500mg metformin HCl). Synthetic reference was 1.35 mg/L (31% too high). Standard FDA PK study value.
